info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v5-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Decline Management API allows businesses to effectively manage declined credit card applications. This endpoint is specifically designed for removing records of credit card applications that have been declined, ensuring that application data remains current and accurate. Common use cases include financial institutions looking to maintain application integrity and compliance requirements. Developers can integrate this API to automate the cleanup of declined applications from their systems.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to decline an application submitted for processing. Declining an application will mark it as rejected and update its status accordingly.

requestBody.description: Request body for declining an application. This action signifies the decision to reject the application, and it requires specific parameters to be passed in the body to process the decline successfully.

200.description: The request was successful and the application has been declined.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: This schema represents the request body that is sent when declining an application. The request body is expected to be a plain string.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the decline operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the decline request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the decline operation.

state.description: The current state of the application after the decline operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the decline request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the decline operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the decline operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.description: Response schema for the decline operation on applications.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information for operations performed on applications.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
